Official @mediapipe/tasks-vision 1.2.3 from npm, Apache-2.0.
Model: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_detector/blaze_face_short_range/float16/1/blaze_face_short_range.tflite
Documentation: https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/face_detector?tab=Web
